question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Faithful
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. **"Loyal"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Faithful: **(वफादार) - Staying loyal and steadfast.

 
 
• **Example**: She was faithful to her promise until the end.
 
 
 
• **Loyal**: (निष्ठावान) - Giving or showing firm and constant support or allegiance.
 
 
• **Example**: He is a loyal friend who stands by me in times of need.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Loyal".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Daring**: (साहसी) - Adventurous or audaciously bold.
 
• **Unfaithful**: (बेवफा) - Not loyal or faithful.
 
• **Cheerful**: (प्रसन्न) - Noticeably happy and optimistic.
